facts.text: Audrey's dogs enjoy going on hikes and show signs of happiness through wagging tails and expressions.

evidence.quote: My dogs go nuts when we go on hikes! They love exploring new scents and being in nature - it's their happy place. I can tell by their wagging tails and expressions how much they love it.

facts.text: Audrey takes safety precautions for her dogs when they are out and about, including using a leash and shoes.

evidence.quote: Safety is super important for me. I even got them something special. They sure look funny, but it works!

facts.text: Audrey and her dogs engage in playing fetch with a ball or frisbee during their walks.

evidence.quote: When I take them out, we usually play fetch with a ball or frisbee. They love chasing it!

facts.text: Audrey and her dogs meet other dog owners in the park for doggie playdates, allowing them to make new friends.

evidence.quote: We also meet other dog owners in the park and have a doggie playdate. It's a great way for me to chat with people and for them to make new friends.
